suite: Independent V2.9 loss command edge review

results.name: Only accepted losses and independently verified receipts enter financial totals
Pending corrections retain accepted figures and acceptance preserves prior revision
An identical transaction reference cannot be justified as a distinct loss
Unavailable loss evidence cannot partially accept a submission
Unavailable receipt evidence cannot partially verify or block rejection
A correction opened before closure cannot be submitted during closure review
Correction approval must still cover the proposed destination scope
Reversal preserves original receipt and changes totals only from its approved date
Legacy loss setup commands cannot insert a malformed unreviewed loss
Completed loss actions keep their earlier accountability when a correction changes the action
